clips.name: Thumb Ear-Wash
clips.summary: Licks its thumb and scrubs inside one big ear, then the other.

clips.name: Wing Eye-Mask
clips.summary: Pulls one wing over its eyes like a sleep mask, then peeks out at you.

clips.name: Cartwheel Landing
clips.summary: Swoops up, does a half-cartwheel and catches the ceiling feet-first.

clips.name: Sunrise Doze
clips.summary: Melts into a deep morning nap, nose bubble and all, then stretches awake.

clips.name: Wattle Wiggle
clips.summary: Its little lip wattles wiggle and its pug nose scrunches.

clips.name: Crèche Babysitter
clips.summary: Tucks three tiny pink pups under one wing and rocks them to sleep.

clips.name: Ram-Horn Ears
clips.summary: Curls both ears back like ram's horns, then tucks them under its wings.

clips.name: Ladybird Listen
clips.summary: Freezes, ears swivelling, to follow a ladybird walking across a leaf.

clips.name: Butterfly Hover
clips.summary: Goes quiet, hovers like a butterfly, and plucks a snack off a leaf.

clips.name: Fruit Hug
clips.summary: Hugs a fruit to its chest and glances left and right for snack thieves.

clips.name: Spat Pop
clips.summary: Squishes the fruit, slurps the juice and spits out a tiny pulp pellet: ptoo!

clips.name: Squabble Squeaks
clips.summary: Squeak-argues with an invisible neighbour over a perch, then scoots over to share.

clips.name: Plum Wrap
clips.summary: Wraps up into a plum-sized ball and sways gently from the ceiling.

clips.name: Peek Twist
clips.summary: Twists around inside its wings to peek at you before deciding you're safe.

clips.name: Find-You Call
clips.summary: Calls into a crowd of tiny sleeping shapes until one answers, then beams.

clips.name: One Big Breath
clips.summary: Snoozes perfectly still, then takes one enormous, slow breath.

clips.name: Groggy Wake
clips.summary: Blinks awake, licks a dewdrop off its fur, mumbles, and is asleep again.

clips.name: Pitcher Plant Bed
clips.summary: Climbs into a pitcher plant like a sleeping bag and settles in.

clips.name: Flap Practice
clips.summary: Hangs and does a burst of frantic wing-flaps, then pants, very proud.

clips.name: Drop Start
clips.summary: Lets go, plops down, remembers to flap, and flutters back up.

clips.name: Almost Landing
clips.summary: Tries the upside-down landing, misses, somersaults, then sticks it in a puff of fluff.

clips.name: Crack Squeeze
clips.summary: Flattens like a pancake and slides into a rock crack until only its mask shows.

clips.name: Bandit Peek
clips.summary: Pops out of its pebble pile wearing its black bandit mask.

clips.name: New Rock Every Day
clips.summary: Each new day it hops to a different pebble and settles in.

clips.name: One-Foot Sway
clips.summary: Hangs by one foot and twirls in the breeze like a ripe berry.

clips.name: Tail Blanket
clips.summary: Wraps itself in its furry tail like a blanket until only its face shows.

clips.name: Berry Bunch
clips.summary: Three tiny pups dangle beside it like a bunch of strawberries.

clips.name: Brush-Tongue Sip
clips.summary: Hovers at a flower and paints out nectar with its brushy tongue.

clips.name: Pollen Sneeze
clips.summary: A pet sends up a puff of pollen from its fur — achoo!

clips.name: Flower Patrol
clips.summary: Shoos a rival off its flower patch, then fluffs up proudly.

clips.name: Moss Hideout
clips.summary: Burrows into a hanging tuft of Spanish moss, ears poking out.

clips.name: Let-Go Drop
clips.summary: Lets go of the moss, drops straight down, and swoops back up.

clips.name: Sprout Planting
clips.summary: Drops a seed as it flies; a tiny sprout pops up behind it.

clips.name: Sunset Compass
clips.summary: Stares at the sunset glow while a tiny compass needle spins and settles.

clips.name: Crowd Dodge
clips.summary: Zig-zags into an invisible crowd of friends and pops out the other side.

clips.name: Batnado
clips.summary: Spirals up in a swirling column of silhouette friends, then streams away like a river.

clips.name: Frost Beads
clips.summary: Tiny droplets bead and sparkle all over its fur while it sleeps.

clips.name: Sleeping Bag
clips.summary: Shivers, then zips itself into its furry tail like a sleeping bag.

clips.name: Great Migration
clips.summary: Pulls on a tiny scarf and flaps off over the horizon — and back.

clips.name: Radar Bloom
clips.summary: A ring of tiny dots blooms around it like a cloud on a weather radar.

clips.name: Gust Surf
clips.summary: A puff of wind catches it and it surfs the gust, ears flapping.

clips.name: Sky-High Snack
clips.summary: Rockets up to the clouds, snaps a snack from the wind and zooms back in speed lines.

clips.name: Moon Shy
clips.summary: When the moon is bright it hides behind a wing and peeks up at it.

clips.name: Katydid Hush
clips.summary: Holds a wing to its lips — shh — and a tiny katydid goes quiet too.

clips.name: Termite-Mound Den
clips.summary: Chews a round, cosy den into a mound and curls up inside.

clips.name: Nest Blend
clips.summary: Fluffs its gold-tipped fur and vanishes into a hanging bird nest.

clips.name: Web Pluck
clips.summary: Hovers at a dewy spider web and plucks off a snack with a flourish.

clips.name: Nest Party
clips.summary: The nest wiggles and golden faces pop out one by one — up to twelve.

clips.name: Blacklight Glow
clips.summary: Its wings flash a soft green glow, as if under a blacklight.

clips.name: Wind Hairs
clips.summary: Tiny hairs on its wings sparkle as it tests the air.

clips.name: Crystal Mend
clips.summary: A crack in one crystal wing glimmers and seals itself shut.

clips.name: Gorilla Gallop
clips.summary: Drops to the ground and gallops along on its wings like a tiny gorilla.

clips.name: Grooming Buddy
clips.summary: Grooms your finger right back — that's how bat friendships start.

clips.name: Share Dinner
clips.summary: Splits its fruit in two and offers you the bigger half.

clips.name: Star-Map Hatch
clips.summary: The egg cracks into a little constellation map that folds into its body.

clips.name: Shortcut Map
clips.summary: Dotted lines draw a shortcut between twinkling fruit trees.

clips.name: Inner Compass
clips.summary: The stars fade out — and the compass inside it still points true.

clips.name: Migration Trail
clips.summary: Draws today's walk across its starry body as a migration route.

clips.name: Storm Surf
clips.summary: Rides a warm wind ahead of a storm, streaking across the whole sky.

clips.name: Totality Hatch
clips.summary: The screen dims to totality and the bat appears inside the golden ring.

clips.name: Whisper Sonar
clips.summary: Sends sonar ripples so tiny that a moth drifts right past without noticing.

clips.name: Halo Ears
clips.summary: Pulls its joined ears down like a hood, then pops them up into a halo.

clips.name: Old-Wood Hideaway
clips.summary: Slips into a crack in an ancient dead tree; only the halo glints.

clips.name: Midday Dusk
clips.summary: In broad daylight the sky darkens; it wakes, peeks out as if dusk came, then shrugs back to sleep.
